title: Crystal structures of QseE and QseG: elements of a three-component system from Escherichia coli.
authors: Matsumoto, Koki; Fukuda, Yohta; Inoue, Tsuyoshi
journal: Acta crystallographica. Section F, Structural biology communications
one_liner_zh: 该研究解析细菌三组分系统QseE/QseG周质区晶体结构，涉及蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA，但使用AlphaFold辅助建模，对蛋白互作结构建模方法有参考价值。
abstract: Bacteria regulate virulence by using two-component systems (TCSs) composed of a histidine kinase (HK) and a response regulator (RR). TCSs respond to environmental signals and change gene-expression levels. The HK QseE and the RR QseF regulate the virulence of Enterobacteriaceae bacteria such as enterohemorrhagic Escherichia coli. The operon encoding QseE/QseF also contains a gene encoding an outer membrane lipoprotein, qseG. The protein product QseG interacts with QseE in the periplasmic space to control the activity of QseE and constitutes a unique QseE/F/G three-component system. However, the structural bases of their functions are unknown. Here, crystal structures of the periplasmic regions of QseE and QseG were determined with the help of AlphaFold models. The periplasmic region of QseE has a helix-bundle structure as found in some HKs. The QseG structure is composed of an N-terminal globular domain and a long C-terminal helix forming a coiled-coil-like structure that contributes to dimerization. Comparison of QseG structures obtained from several crystallization conditions shows that QseG has structural polymorphisms at the C-terminus of the coiled-coil structure, indicating that the C-terminus is flexible. The C-terminal flexibility is derived from conserved hydrophilic residues that reduce the hydrophobic interaction at the coiled-coil interface. Electrostatic surface analysis suggests that the C-terminal coiled-coil region can interact with QseE. The observed structural fluctuation of the C-terminus of QseG is probably important for interaction with QseE.
abstract_zh: 细菌通过由组氨酸激酶（histidine kinase, HK）和反应调节因子（response regulator, RR）组成的双组分系统（two-component systems, TCSs）来调控毒力。TCSs响应环境信号并改变基因表达水平。HK QseE和RR QseF调控肠杆菌科细菌（如肠出血性大肠杆菌）的毒力。编码QseE/QseF的操纵子还包含一个编码外膜脂蛋白qseG的基因。蛋白质产物QseG在周质空间中与QseE相互作用，以控制QseE的活性，并构成独特的QseE/F/G三组分系统。然而，其功能的结构基础尚不清楚。在此，借助AlphaFold模型，确定了QseE和QseG周质区域的晶体结构。QseE的周质区域具有螺旋束结构，这与某些HK中发现的相似。QseG结构由N端球状结构域和长C端螺旋组成，后者形成有助于二聚化的卷曲螺旋样结构。从多种结晶条件获得的QseG结构比较显示，QseG在卷曲螺旋结构的C端存在结构多态性，表明C端是柔性的。C端的柔性源于保守的亲水性残基，这些残基减少了卷曲螺旋界面处的疏水相互作用。静电表面分析表明，C端卷曲螺旋区域可以与QseE相互作用。观察到的QseG C端结构波动可能对其与QseE的相互作用至关重要。
